newsitem.title: USA: Giant unit sues over abortion-inducing drug.
newsitem.headline: Giant unit sues over abortion-inducing drug.

text.p: KCC Delaware, a unit of Giant Group Ltd, said it filed suit on Thursday to enforce its contract to participate in the development and manufacture of the abortion-inducing drug mifepristone.
The suit, filed in California Superior Court, names as defendants Joseph Pike, Population Council Inc and Advances in Health Technologies Inc.
KCC said Pike obtained a sublicense to manufacture and distribute mifepristone in the U.S. and elsewhere from Population Council and Advances in Health.
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration recently approved mifepristone as an abortion-inducing drug.
"KCC has filed this action in order to preserve its rights and to protect itself, the other limited partners and the investing public from Mr Pike's continuing improper activity," KCC said.
